गौधार m. (-रः) An iguana.
 E. गोधा an alligator, and आरक् affix of des-
cent; considered as the offspring of the alligator, on account of
its smaller size, and similar shape; also गौधेय and गौधेर.

गौधेय m. (-यः) An iguana.
 E. गोधा, and ढक् affix: see the last.

गौधेर m. (-रः) An iguana.
 E. गोधा, and ढक् affix; see गौधारः
